title: Grill Faceledger design with domain docs
description: Resolve the consequential unknowns and assumptions in DESIGN-SEED.md through a scenario-driven interview, updating the domain glossary and recording only qualifying durable decisions as ADRs.
acceptance_criteria: The grilling session resolves enough product and domain decisions for to-spec; settled terminology is captured in CONTEXT.md, qualifying decisions are captured as ADRs, and remaining unknowns stay explicit.
notes: Grilling completed. DESIGN-SEED.md and CONTEXT.md now capture settled comparison, cache maintenance, diagnostics, Linux support, privacy, recovery, concurrency, and scale rules. PARKED-PLAN.md preserves deferred CLI, GUI, verification, packaging, and implementation work. Added ADRs through 0005 and Linux support research. Q17 runtime locking and Q30 model licensing remain intentionally explicit pre-distribution investigations.
close_reason: Grilling complete; design seed is ready for to-spec with Q17 explicitly deferred to a packaging spike.
